metadata.name: Photoresistor Light Sensor
metadata.description: Voltage divider circuit using photoresistor and 10kΩ resistor to detect light levels via analog input

wires.description: Wire from Pico 3.3V to top power rail at 10W. Provides power to voltage divider.
Wire from power rail to photoresistor pin0 at 10J. Connects 3.3V to top of voltage divider.
Wire from Pico ADC pin GP26 to junction at 13G. Reads voltage between photoresistor and resistor.
Wire from Pico ground to bottom ground rail at 10Z. Establishes ground reference.
Wire from ground rail to resistor pin1 at 16G. Connects bottom of voltage divider to ground.
